changeSet.sql: insert into WEB_ORIGINS(CLIENT_ID, VALUE) select c.ID, concat('/realms/', c.REALM_ID, '/account/*') from CLIENT c where c.CLIENT_ID = 'account-console' and REALM_ID not in ('master', 'manager') and not exists (select * from WEB_ORIGINS wo where wo.CLIENT_ID = c.ID);

changeSet.author: korotaev.miu
changeSet.comment: Clients > account-console > Client Scopes > account-console-dedicated + Add mappers: client roles
changeSet.sql: insert ignore into PROTOCOL_MAPPER(ID, NAME, PROTOCOL, PROTOCOL_MAPPER_NAME, CLIENT_ID) select concat('2b88e952-ab68-4a86-9c34-', cast(lpad(row_number() over (order by c.ID), 12, '0') as CHAR)), 'client roles', 'openid-connect', 'oidc-usermodel-client-role-mapper', c.ID from CLIENT c where c.CLIENT_ID = 'account-console' and not exists ( select * from PROTOCOL_MAPPER pm where pm.CLIENT_ID = c.ID and pm.NAME = 'client roles' ); insert ignore into PROTOCOL_MAPPER_CONFIG(PROTOCOL_MAPPER_ID, NAME, VALUE) select pm.ID as PROTOCOL_MAPPER_ID, q.NAME, q.VALUE from ( select 'access.token.claim' as NAME, 'true' as VALUE union all select 'claim.name', 'resource_access.\$\{client_id}.roles' union all select 'introspection.token.claim', 'true' union all select 'jsonType.label', 'String' union all select 'multivalued', 'true' union all select 'user.attribute', 'foo' ) q, PROTOCOL_MAPPER pm where pm.ID like '2b88e952-ab68-4a86-9c34-%';

changeSet.sql: insert into SETTINGS(ID, REALM_ID, EXT_ID, VALUE, `DESC`, NAME, UNIT, `TYPE`) select concat(substring(uuid(), 1, 24), cast(lpad(row_number() over (order by EXT_ID), 12, '0') as CHAR)) as ID, 'ER-TELECOM' as REALM_ID, EXT_ID, VALUE, `DESC`, NAME, UNIT, `TYPE` from SETTINGS s where REALM_ID = 'user' and EXT_ID in ('emailEnabledAccountBodyHtml', 'emailDisabledAccountBodyHtml') and not exists(select * from SETTINGS where EXT_ID = s.EXT_ID and REALM_ID = 'ER-TELECOM'); insert into SETTINGS(ID, REALM_ID, EXT_ID, VALUE, `DESC`, NAME, UNIT, `TYPE`) select concat(substring(uuid(), 1, 24), cast(lpad(row_number() over (order by EXT_ID), 12, '0') as CHAR)) as ID, 'S-TELECOM' as REALM_ID, EXT_ID, VALUE, `DESC`, NAME, UNIT, `TYPE` from SETTINGS s where REALM_ID = 'user' and EXT_ID in ('emailEnabledAccountBodyHtml', 'emailDisabledAccountBodyHtml') and not exists(select * from SETTINGS where EXT_ID = s.EXT_ID and REALM_ID = 'S-TELECOM');
